text: CLI output carries ids, counts and group IDs only; never print captured command or error text.
Failure records are immutable files written once through atomic_create; repeated failures stay separate records, so never rewrite or deduplicate stored records.
Failure groups are exact: group_id hashes repo, command and error. Do not add fuzzy or normalized matching.
ingest validates the whole batch before saving any record; on any error nothing is imported.
propose without --group already builds the group listing with count, recurring flag and evidence IDs; extend that branch instead of adding a second listing.
Error messages are fixed text that never include input content; main prints 'coldfix: <message>' and exits 2.
Split stored text only at \n. str.splitlines() also splits at U+2028, U+2029 and U+0085 and silently changes the text.
tests/test_cli.py runs the CLI as a subprocess against a temporary store; add behavior tests there.
coldfix.py is stdlib only; add no third-party imports.
